record_title: One-moment reduction for symmetric occupancy statistics under pairwise-independent uniforms
provenance: A symmetry reduction for occupancy-invariant statistics under uniform pairwise independence, with exact sharp collision-free probability bounds.
limitations: The reduction applies to coordinate- and common-label-invariant objectives on a finite uniform alphabet. It does not characterize nonsymmetric objectives, nonuniform marginals, or higher k-wise independence. Equivalent formulations may exist in finite exchangeability, weighted orthogonal-array, universal-hashing, or probability-bounds literature.
